title: Arlo Dining Chair
tagline: A light, sturdy chair for everyday meals

content.text: Arlo's seat and back are shaped from thick oak veneer, pressed over a mould we made in the workshop. The result is a chair that weighs just five kilos and takes years of daily use in its stride.
The gently curved back supports you through a long dinner, and the chairs stack two high when you need the floor space.

care: Wipe with a soft, damp cloth and dry straight away. Re-oil once or twice a year with the care kit included.
